mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, compressing valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, reducing corporate investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO and HOUST both decline by >0.5% in the past month over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.0%), a further acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change rise > 0.1%) signals imminent monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL monthly change rise > 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 2.0% and rises by >0.1% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS increases by >0.5% in the past month over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900,000 units indicates weakening residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and retail sales, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST falls below 900.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates monetary tightening in a weak labor market, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in weak labor market
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises by >0.1% and UNRATE > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO decline > 1.0% in past month), a further decline in industrial production signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO declines by >1.0% over any 3-year rolling window.
